faq.label: STAFF HELP
faq.title: Help using Campaign Centre
faq.subtitle: Frequently asked questions for authorised Charis staff.

sections.title: How do I send to one customer?
sections.description: Open Create campaign, select individual recipients, search and choose the eligible customer.

sections.title: Can I send to an uploaded group?
sections.description: Upload a CSV or Excel file, save its contacts as a group, then choose that group while creating a campaign.

sections.title: Why can’t I send immediately?
sections.description: The sender, permissions, contact eligibility, approvals and delivery configuration must be verified before a live campaign can be released.

sections.title: Does it send SMS or WhatsApp?
sections.description: The current release supports email delivery. Other channels require separate integrations.
